title: Finite measurable partitions of compact abelian groups have a cell whose φ₁(A)−φ₁(A)+φ₂(A) contains a uniform Bohr set for commuting finite-index endomorphisms
author: Anh N. Le and Thái Hoàng Lê
difficulty_reason: The proof creates monochromatic homomorphism patterns with disjoint variable supports through an iterated multidimensional Hales-Jewett construction. Integrating these patterns and controlling finite-index pushforwards gives a uniform positive configuration count. A Fourier continuity estimate and a finite-index image argument upgrade the count to a Bohr neighborhood inside the selected cell sumset.
